name: git-secret-guard
description: Blocks secrets and credentials from reaching git history, and manages .gitignore safely — with an explicit, diffable, user-approved advisor.

gitSecretGuard.blockCommitOnSecret.description: Hard-block a commit when the pre-commit hook finds a high-confidence secret. When false, the hook warns but still allows the commit.

gitSecretGuard.scanOnSave.description: Scan the active file for secrets on save and show editor diagnostics.

gitSecretGuard.customRulesPath.description: Path to additional gitleaks-format TOML rules, merged with the bundled default ruleset.

gitSecretGuard.allowlistPath.description: Path to a user-maintained gitleaks-format TOML allowlist (paths/regexes/stopwords), merged into the effective config. This is the only supported way to suppress a false positive.

gitSecretGuard.gitleaksPath.description: Override the gitleaks binary location. When empty, resolves a bundled binary if present, otherwise 'gitleaks' from PATH.

gitSecretGuard.autoDetectProjectType.description: Enable the .gitignore Advisor's automatic project-type detection. The secret-shaped-file detector is independent and always stays on.

gitSecretGuard.notifyOnNewManifest.description: Show a dismissible notification when a new manifest file (e.g. package.json) appears mid-session, offering updated .gitignore suggestions.
